steps.title: Grouping, regions, coverage renderer, Sinkhorn and LS objectives (work item 1)
steps.result: Coverage mass on stock-rendered lit pixels at the ground truth: median 99.6% (min 95.2%) over 20 grad grains; ground-truth map groups into exactly the 497 grains; Sinkhorn at ground truth 0.4-0.7 px^2 after component + ratio filters and reach 3 px.

steps.title: Objective bias: where each objective's minimum sits against the ground truth
steps.result: Only the strict cost (grain mean) puts its optimum within 0.01 deg of the ground truth (0.006, 0.008 deg); Sinkhorn variants are flat within 0.031-0.041 deg (objective <1% lower); intensity-weighted Sinkhorn 0.0074 / 0.026 deg; least squares 0.012 / 0.042 deg.

steps.title: Deformed samples: random (rand) and correlated (corr3) voxel-to-voxel misorientation, RMS 0.5-5 deg
steps.result: Rendered: rand 22.4M lit pixels, corr3 19.2M; coverage mass on lit pixels at the ground truth 97-99%. At 2 / 5 deg, 69% / 97% of neighbour pairs in rand exceed 2 deg (flood-fill grouping fails there).

steps.title: Survey of strain code in older C++ branches
steps.result: Strain only in the C++ image simulator (g = O M g0, M ~ I - eps); no fitter or cost exists; branches identical. Reuse convention, .mic columns 13-18, config keys.

steps.title: Optimizer Pareto on G20 (20 grad grains, painted start)
steps.result: Frontier: grain-field CMA on the strict cost. At 100 objective evaluations per voxel, 3 of 853 voxels > 0.1 deg (the 3 paint errors) vs 18 for AR3 per-voxel CMA, at half its wall time; 400 evaluations: median 0.0062 deg. Per-voxel CMA alone, quadratic fields and Sinkhorn/LS basin stages add nothing from the painted start (Sinkhorn: 700x wall time).

steps.title: Robustness on rand / corr3 (0.5-5 deg RMS), grain-centre start
steps.result: Local fits recover only voxels within ~0.5 deg of their start. corr3 0.5 deg: 99% to 32% of voxels > 0.1 deg (median 0.414 to 0.071); corr3 1 deg: 53% (LS + field + coarse polish); corr3 2-5 deg and rand >= 1 deg: almost nothing. The linear field alone does not move them; coarse per-voxel steps (0.3 deg) beat fine ones.

steps.title: Far starts: per-voxel step ladder and neighbour continuation on rand / corr3
steps.result: Step ladder 1.0/0.3/0.05 deg with 61 evaluations per leg: corr3 0.5/1/2 deg -> 9%/11%/47% of voxels > 0.1 deg (GO4 best 32/53/93%), at 196 eval/voxel. rand stays hard (51% at 0.5 deg). The strict cost prefers the ground truth for ~all unresolved voxels: a search problem, and a high strict cost flags them.

steps.title: Larger per-voxel ladders (3 deg first leg) on rand / corr3
steps.result: L/366/3 (4 legs x 91, 401 eval/voxel): corr3 0.5/1/2/5 deg -> 3/9/31/72% of voxels > 0.1 deg (medians ~0.01 deg up to 2 deg); rand 48/53/77/83%. 5 deg needs a global per-voxel search (I36, blocked on ray-index cost).

steps.title: Strain in the forward model (SpotModel and stock renderer) and the strained sample
steps.result: Opt-in strain, g = O M g0 with M = (I+eps)^-1, tests pin the sign and frame; default bit-identical. Sample `strain` (RMS 1e-4 / 5e-4 / 1e-3 per grain). Near field: 0.2-0.5 px spot shift per 1e-3 strain; intensity Sinkhorn rises 10% at ~1e-3 per component; leaving strain out raises it 14-44% at 1e-3, 0.3% at 1e-4.

steps.title: Per-grain strain fit (field + 6 strain numbers) on the coverage cost
steps.result: Median strain error (12 grains) at levels 1e-4/5e-4/1e-3: strain only at ground-truth orientation 1.7e-4/1.9e-4/2.0e-4 (floor ~2e-4, half of pixel/distance); field + strain from ground truth 3.1e-4/3.4e-4/3.8e-4; from painted start 6.7e-4/6.3e-4/5.3e-4. Joint fits stop above the ground truth's cost in 19 of 24 grains: optimizer-limited. Orientation stays at 0.010-0.016 deg.

steps.title: Joint orientation + strain fit that reaches the optimum
steps.result: Median strain error at 1e-4/5e-4/1e-3 from the painted start: joint 2400 evaluations 6.5/5.7/4.5e-4 with only 2 of 12 grains short of the ground truth's cost (10 of 12 below it): objective-limited, orientation (0.01 deg) trades with strain (2-4e-4). Staged (strain first, then joint) 7.1/3.4/3.0e-4; floor at the ground-truth orientation 1.7/1.9/2.0e-4.

pareto_note: Vertical axis: voxels more than 0.1 deg from the ground truth, as a percentage of all voxels in the set, pooled over grains (not a per-grain average). Horizontal axis: objective evaluations per voxel. Grey: reference points, set = all 19,013 painted voxels of grad. Coloured: GO2 arms, set = the 853 voxels of the 20 benchmark grains (G20) that have an AR3 C record (start 84 of 853, C 18 of 853).
